name: Rolling ride warehouse
desc: Hypnotic rolling flavor: boomy low-tuned penv kick, shuffled triplet-feel ride carrying the top end, polymetric uzu tom figure walking through iter, dropout fills that thin the phrase end instead of doubling it. Tribal-leaning where .01 is a straight pounder.

code.full: stack(note("a0*4").s("sine").penv(${penv}).pdec(.09).decay(.45).sustain(0).shape(.35).gain(${gain}), s("[rd@2 rd]*4").gain(saw.range(.14, .3).fast(4)).lpf(sine.range(${bright}*.4, ${bright}).slow(32)), s("{lt ~ mt ~ ht ~ ~}%4").gain(.3).iter(4), s("~ sh ~ sh").gain(.22)).lastOf(8, x=>x.degradeBy(.3)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(note("a0*4").s("sine").penv(${penv}).pdec(.08).decay(.5).sustain(0).shape(.4).gain(${gain}), s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.7), s("[rd rd]*4").gain(saw.range(.16, .34).fast(4)).lpf(sine.range(${bright}*.5, ${bright}).slow(16)), s("{lt mt ht sh}%4").gain(.3).iter(8), s("~ ~ cp ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.45).room(.2)).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(1).play()
